instructions.adding-a-post: When you create a new post, add an entry here with version, date, URL, title, type (release|research|bugfix), tags, and summary
instructions.version-naming: Use semantic versioning (0.3.7) not dot notation (0-3-7) for version field; folder names use dashes
instructions.tags: Use lowercase, dashes for multi-word tags. Examples: user-research, accessibility, boundary-drawing, mobile, bugfix
